title: MV Follow-Up Attack when enemy is afflicted with a state help

posts.author: squidnogi
posts.body:
Hello! First off I'd like to apologize if I'm posting this in the wrong area or something, its my first time posting on the forum
I have a character called Robbie, who inflicts a state called Destabilized on enemies. I want it so that when an ally hits an enemy with the Destabilized state, Robbie launches his follow-up attack onto that enemy. I understand the basics of what I'm trying to do but I can't seem to get it to work via scripts (which is how I'd like to do it to avoid having to paste a common event into every single skill in my database.
My JS knowledge is very very limited, so I asked chatGPT to help me hoping that it would be a simple enough task for it to handle, and this is what I have
JavaScript:
if ($gameTroop.members().some(enemy => enemy === target && enemy.isStateAffected(24))) {

    $gameTemp.reserveCommonEvent(7);

}
and I have it under the Battle Events Page like so:
Spoiler:
Battle Event Image
The Common Event that I am running is simply a Force Action event:
Spoiler:
Common Event
If someone could help me, I'd really appriciate it!!!!

squidnogi said:
hoping that it would be a simple enough task for it to handle
Click to expand...
There's almost no such thing. AI generators
generate
things, they make things up. Code can't function if it's made up. That's why humans learn how to do it.
In the example you give, it's done in completely the wrong way (troop event) with completely the wrong code (there's no such thing as target).
You should be using a plugin like Yanfly's Buffs & States to do the force action script call when the battler with the state gets hit.
